title: Returns & Exchanges Inspection Fee Schedule
content:
The Returns & Exchanges inspection fee schedule sets, for each return type, the restocking terms for grade B units, the per-unit box fee on footwear, the treatment of grade C units and the fee for sending a rejected unit back. Amounts are in USD.

| Return type | Restocking fees charged | Grade B restocking percentage | Restocking fee cap per unit | Missing box fee per footwear unit | Grade C units | Send-back fee for a rejected unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | Yes | 15 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 | Rejected and sent back | 0.00 |
| Store Credit Return | Yes | 15 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 | Rejected and sent back | 0.00 |
| Size Exchange | No | 0 percent | 0.00 | 0.00 | Rejected and sent back | 0.00 |
| Instant Exchange | No | 0 percent | 0.00 | 0.00 | Rejected and sent back | 0.00 |
| Gift Return | Yes | 15 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 | Rejected and sent back | 0.00 |
| Quality Issue Return | No | 0 percent | 0.00 | 0.00 | Accepted as defective | 0.00 |

## Grades referred to

- Grade B: unworn, tags detached.
- Grade C: worn, washed, altered or damaged.
- Missing box fee: charged per footwear unit returned without its original box or in a box used as the shipping carton.

## Reading across the tiers

- Three types carry restocking and box terms (Standard Return, Store Credit Return, Gift Return); the two exchanges and the Quality Issue Return carry none, and their percentage, cap and box fee are all zero.
- The Quality Issue Return is the only type on which a grade C unit is accepted, as defective, rather than rejected and sent back.
- Sending a rejected unit back costs the customer nothing on every type.
